Oct 20 : Turkey have appointed Sergen Yalcin as head coach on a four-year contract to replace the sacked Italian Vincenzo Montella, the country's football federation (TFF) announced on Tuesday. The 53-year-old former Turkey midfielder steps into the job following Montella's dismissal earlier this month after a difficult UEFA Nations League campaign. Turkey sit bottom of Group A1 after four consecutive losses, having also suffered a group stage exit from the 2026 World Cup. "We wish Yalcin success in his new role and hope this decision proves auspicious for our country and our national team," the TFF said in a statement.

As a manager, Yalcin guided Besiktas to a domestic double of Super Lig and Turkish Cup in the 2020–21 season. He ended a second stint in charge of Besiktas in May.

item.title: US FDA issues guidance on apps used with prescription drugs
item.description: The US FDA on Tuesday issued guidance aimed at clarifying how drug companies can develop, distribute and label apps used alongside their prescription medicines.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA on Tuesday issued guidance aimed at clarifying how drug companies can develop, distribute and label apps used alongside their prescription medicines. Here are some details: The policy outlines when content in such apps must be submitted to the US Food and Drug Administration, when those apps should be referenced in a drug's prescribing information, and what information companies need to provide to the health regulator. Apps linked to medical devices, such as software paired with an asthma inhaler, should generally be included in an associated drug's label, the FDA said Standalone apps that track symptoms, provide reminders or offer coaching should be listed in the label only if these apps are essential for the medicine's safe and effective use or offer meaningful clinical benefit, it said In most cases, information displayed to patients through a companion app will be treated as promotional material, in line with the regulator's approach to other forms of drug advertising The FDA said the guidance intends to reduce regulatory uncertainty for drugmakers and technology developers while maintaining safety and effectiveness standards

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナ西部のエネ施設にも攻撃拡大 停電相次ぐ
item.description: [キーウ ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ　２０日　ロイター] - ロシアは、ウクライナ東部および中部に加え、これまで標的にしていなかった西部地域のエネルギー施設にも攻撃を拡大しており、各地で停電が相次いでいる。ウクライナのエネルギー省当局者や地元当局が２０日、明らかにした

ウクライナのネクラソフ・エネルギー相代理はテレビ演説で「残念ながら、敵は引き続き意図的かつ組織的にわれわれのエネルギーインフラを攻撃している」とし、「攻撃の結果、一部の消費者が停電に見舞われた」と述べた。

同氏によると、ロシアは中部キロボフラード州、西部のジトーミル、リビウ、リブネ、テルノピリ、フメリニツキーの各州、南部オデーサのエネルギー施設を攻撃した。

ロシアは寒冷期入りを前にした１０月、ウクライナのエネルギー部門への攻撃を再開し、発電所や送電システムを標的にしている。ウクライナ最大の民間エネルギー会社ＤＴＥＫは２０日、ロシアによる夜間攻撃でオデーサにある同社のエネルギー施設３カ所が被弾し、３万２７００世帯が停電状態にあると明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー大統領は１８日、トランプ米大統領が１１日に、ロシアとウクライナがエネルギー施設への攻撃停止に合意したと突然発表して以降の１週間で、ロシアはウクライナのエネルギー、石油・ガス部門を数十回にわたり攻撃したと明らかにした。

item.title: ＧＭ、通期ＥＰＳ予想が市場予想に届かず 第3四半期は増益
item.description:
Kalea Hall
[２０日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が２０日発表した第３・四半期決...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭ、通期ＥＰＳ予想が市場予想に届かず　第3四半期は増益 10/20 23:07 配信

2019年1月13日撮影。REUTERS/Rebecca Cook

Kalea Hall

[２０日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が２０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、ピックアップトラックの販売が好調で中核的な利益が大幅に増加した。ただ、通期の１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）見通しがアナリスト予想を下回り、株価は下落した。

ＧＭは２０２６年通期の一時的な項目を除いた金利・税引き前利益（調整後ＥＢＩＴ）について、従来予想の１４０億─１６０億ドルから１４５億─１５５億ドルへとレンジを狭めた。

この結果、通期の１株当たり調整後ＥＰＳ予想は１２．７５─１３．７５ドルとなった。ＧＭ予想の中央値はＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の中央値１３．４１ドルを下回っている。

ＧＭ株は序盤の取引で約５％下落した。

第３・四半期の調整後ＥＢＩＴは前年同期比２２％増の４１億ドルとなった。１株当たりでは３．７０ドルとなり、ＬＳＥＧのデータに基づくアナリスト予想の３．６３ドルを上回った。

第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比２．９％増の５００億ドル。北米事業の利益率は、四半期販売台数がわずかに減少したものの、前年同期の６．２％から８．７％に改善した。

大型ピックアップトラックの販売構成比が高まる一方、電気自動車（ＥＶ）の販売が減少し、収益を押し上げた。ＥＶは従来赤字が続いているうえ、トランプ米政権のＥＶ支援撤回を受け、ＧＭはＥＶ販売を縮小している。

ＧＭは「今後の道のりはより厳しくなる」としたものの、消費者の底堅い需要が続き、コモディティーや物流分野でのコスト圧力が和らぐことを前提に、来年の業績は改善するとの見通しを改めて示した。

ＧＭ取締役会は、複数年にわたる総額２００億ドルの自社株買いプログラムを承認した。ＧＭは２０２３年以降で約２９５億ドルの自社株を買い戻している。

item.title: Regulador chileno investiga las pérdidas en fondos de pensiones de menor riesgo
item.description: La Superintendencia de Pensiones de Chile dijo el martes que inició un procedimiento para perseguir sanciones contra las siete administradoras que operan en el país debido a las recientes pérdidas en sus fondos de menor riesgo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Superintendencia de Pensiones de Chile dijo el martes que inició un procedimiento para perseguir sanciones contra las siete administradoras que operan en el país debido a las recientes pérdidas en sus fondos de menor riesgo. Las Administradoras de Fondos de Pensiones (AFP) han sido objeto de duras críticas debido a una caída de más del 10% del fondo de menor riesgo entre enero y septiembre, atribuida al alza de las tasas de interés en Estados Unidos, que provocó fuertes pérdidas en inversiones en derivados. El sistema privado de pensiones es operado por las AFP, que manejan cinco fondos de inversión que van desde el Fondo A, de más riesgo, hasta el conservador E, que está pensado para proteger los ahorros de quienes están prontos a jubilar. "Tras concluir todas las acciones de fiscalización respecto de las pérdidas de valor que han afectado particularmente a los Fondos de Pensiones Tipo D y E, decidió iniciar un proceso sancionatorio a cada una de las siete administradoras de fondos de pensiones (AFP) por su responsabilidad en las decisiones de inversión adoptadas", dijo en un comunicado. La medida busca determinar "si habrían incumplido o no" su función de "cautelar la obtención de una adecuada rentabilidad y seguridad en las inversiones". En un comunicado reciente tras conocerse las pérdidas, la Asociación de AFP de Chile trató de tranquilizar a los aportantes, afirmando que el rendimiento de los fondos de pensiones debe evaluarse en un largo plazo y no basarse en las fluctuaciones del mercado a corto plazo. La Asociación no respondió inmediatamente el martes a una solicitud de comentarios. En Chile operan Provida, Cuprum y Habitat de las estadounidenses Metlife, Principal y Prudential, respectivamente; Capital de la colombiana Sura, Vital de la italiana Generali, así como las locales Modelo y Uno. El actual sistema chileno privado de pensiones se puso en marcha en la década de 1980, durante la dictadura de Augusto Pinochet. El sistema lleva mucho tiempo bajo críticas por generar pensiones relativamente bajas, mientras que sus administradores obtienen sólidos beneficios. Tras años de debate político, el Congreso aprobó una importante reforma en 2025, cuya implantación comenzó por fases a partir de agosto del año pasado y se extenderá por varios años.

item.title: Ahead of elections, Bessent says a Democrat-led Congress could do little to stop Trump agenda
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday that there was not much a Democrat-led House of Representatives could do to stop the Trump administration's agenda.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday that there was not much a Democrat-led House of Representatives could do to stop the Trump administration's agenda. "I think there's very little," Bessent said in an interview on 2Way TV two weeks ahead of November's midterm elections. "We have very durable tariff authorities," he said, referring to Democrats' opposition to Trump broadly imposing tariffs on goods imported from countries around the world. Control of Congress is at stake as voters head to the polls on November 3 to choose members of the House of Representatives and Senate and governors in states across the country. The Republican Party currently has a narrow majority in both the Senate and the House of Representatives. The election comes as Trump's [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"approval rating"] has dipped over his handling of the high cost of living for Americans during the US-Israeli war with Iran that has raised fuel prices. Bessent said the Treasury's effort to isolate Iran economically was working. "We haven't seen any loadings at the Iranian oil facility on Kharg Island since August. Iran currently has no oil on the water," he said. "Panic is starting to set in ... I don't know whether it's going to take four more weeks or eight more weeks, but at a point, their economy will go nonlinear," he said. Bessent also said he had not heard whether Russian President Vladimir Putin had accepted Trump's invitation to attend the G20 summit in Florida in December. "I haven't seen his RSVP yea or nay yet," Bessent said. Trump has said Russia has agreed to supply diesel to global markets, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel designed to deprive Moscow of revenue for its war in Ukraine .

item.title: China says US' DeepSeek ban disregards Xi-Trump consensus
item.description: China's commerce ministry on Tuesday criticised a US government order banning Chinese AI model DeepSeek from federal agency IT systems, saying it harmed Chinese firms' interests and disregarded understandings reached by the countries' leaders.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's commerce ministry on Tuesday criticised a US government [USN:L1N4650HF TEXT:"order banning"] Chinese AI model DeepSeek from federal agency IT systems, saying it harmed Chinese firms' interests and disregarded understandings reached by the countries' leaders. In a statement, the ministry urged the US to "immediately correct wrong practices ... and revoke relevant discriminatory restrictive measures," adding that Beijing would closely monitor developments and "take all necessary measures" to safeguard its interests. The US Homeland Security Department on Monday ordered the removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services using the Chinese AI model from civilian federal agency IT systems. It also barred agencies from acquiring DeepSeek products or third-party services developed using the model. DHS said DeepSeek models pose "multiple threat vectors" and raised concerns that their use could result in the transfer of sensitive data to China if used by US government employees or vendors. Beijing is "strongly dissatisfied and firmly opposes" the order, the commerce ministry said. China hopes the US will implement the consensus reached by the two leaders, work with China "in the same direction" and make full use of the China-US [USN:AZN4TK3M7 TEXT:"artificial intelligence dialogue"] mechanism, it added. In a separate statement on Tuesday, the ministry also voiced "firm opposition" against US sanctions on five Chinese entities over alleged AI trade secret theft. The companies sanctioned by the US State Department on Monday were Shanghai Zhisuan Technology — an AI firm founded by former Google software engineer Linwei Ding — a venture capital firm that funded Zhisuan as well as three related entities. Ding was [USN:L6N3YU1BO TEXT:"found guilty"] in January of stealing AI trade secrets from the US tech giant to benefit two Chinese companies, although his conviction was [USN:L6N44H17F TEXT:"partially overturned"] in August. The Chinese ministry accused the US of "hyping up the so-called 'trade secret theft' issue" and of smearing Chinese firms. The rapid development of AI firms in China is the result of long-term investment and a commitment to technological self-reliance and open cooperation, and has nothing to do with trade secret theft, Beijing said.

item.title: Genetic study shows seafarers from Easter Island settled Hawaii
item.description: Oct 20 : It was a difficult, almost incomprehensible, feat. A band of seafarers from Easter Island in the South Pacific set off in double-hulled sailing canoes on a voyage across Earth's largest ocean that ended more than 4,400 miles (7,100 km) away in Hawaii, the only Polynesian island in the Northern Hemisphere.

Genetic study shows seafarers from Easter Island settled Hawaii

FAST

Oct 20 : It was a difficult, almost incomprehensible, feat. A band of seafarers from Easter Island in the South Pacific set off in double-hulled sailing canoes on a voyage across Earth's largest ocean that ended more than 4,400 miles (7,100 km) away in Hawaii, the only Polynesian island in the Northern Hemisphere. But this oceanic odyssey centuries ago was no myth. New genetic research has determined that Native Hawaiians are genetically most closely related to the people of Easter Island, also called Rapa Nui. "Using whole genomes, our algorithms can find DNA sequences matching perfectly between individuals on different islands, the legacy of common ancestors. From these data we can create family trees of the islands," said Stanford University computational geneticist Alexander Ioannidis, co-senior author of the study published in the journal Science.  The findings point to a founding population of people from Easter Island arriving in Hawaii as the first humans to settle the lush volcanic island chain.

The data indicated that the people who settled Easter Island arrived there in the 1200s after journeying from Mangareva island in French Polynesia, more than 1,500 miles (2,400 km) away, and that a subset of them subsequently set off for Hawaii. That voyage likely occurred in the same century, Ioannidis said. "We examined shared segments of DNA, genetic variation and thousands of reconstructed family trees. In 61 per cent of those trees, Hawaii and Rapa Nui were paired together. We checked it four different ways because, frankly, we were dumbfounded and couldn't believe it ourselves at first," said genome scientist and study co-senior author Keolu Fox of the University of California, San Diego. It would have been an incredible journey, Ioannidis said. "In their canoes, they brought with them plants that they would need on the newly settled island, and they included bananas, taro and sweet potato, as well as animals like the chicken. It is believed that the Polynesians would embark on these voyages across thousands of miles of ocean in order to discover new islands rich in resources and land to settle," Ioannidis said. The researchers pieced together these long-ago journeys based on genetic data revealing the relatedness of present-day people from various Polynesian islands, analyzing DNA from more than 1,000 Polynesian people. These included 317 Native Hawaiians, 12 Rapa Nui and 8 Mangarevans, as well as others from the Society, Tuamotu, Marquesas, Austral, Samoan and Tongan islands. The genetic data showed Mangarevan ancestry was second only to Easter Island ancestry for Native Hawaiians. MONUMENTAL SEA CROSSINGS The researchers attribute these monumental sea crossings to an ultravoyaging population they call Holomoana Nui, the Hawaiian phrase for "great ocean voyaging," with Hawaii as the last destination reached. They were the greatest voyaging community in human history, according to Fox, who is a Native Hawaiian. "Polynesians were exploring and settling the Pacific centuries before Europeans began their celebrated voyages of discovery," Fox said. "Perhaps it's time to rethink who we call explorers." Using genetic data, the researchers previously tracked how Polynesian voyagers reached a succession of islands over a period of centuries in one of the most impressive settlement feats in human history, but that study traced them only as far as Easter Island. THE FOUNDING OF TAHITI The new study included a detailed genomic analysis of people from Tahiti, one of the Society Islands and the locale for which the researchers had the most genomes. They were able to estimate the size and date of the founding generation — roughly 800 people reaching Tahiti around the year 1070. "Since the voyage to Hawaii was much longer, we would expect its founding population size to have been no larger and likely smaller," Ioannidis said. Native Hawaiians and Easter Islanders share many cultural traits found among eastern Polynesians, including a similar Austronesian language and similar foods, Ioannidis said. The study has implications for disease risk among Native Hawaiians and other Polynesians due to genetic bottlenecks called "founder effects." These arise when a small portion of a population separates and founds a new population, as the Polynesians did each time they ventured to and settled on a new island. This narrowing of the gene pool can amplify the frequency of some rare genetic variants sometimes related to diseases, while others vanish entirely, Ioannidis said. The Polynesians repeated the pattern of settling on new lands, intensifying the effect. "Repeated founder effects concentrated rare disease-associated variants in Polynesian populations. We identified variants linked to kidney disease and blindness that occur at surprisingly high frequencies in French Polynesia," Fox said. Founder effects have been extensively studied in certain populations including the Amish, Ashkenazi Jews and Finns, leading to standard screenings for certain genetic conditions for them. "Why not Hawaiians?" Fox asked.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Flávio promete recriar benefício ao setor de eventos instituído na pandemia e encerrado por Lula
item.description: O candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) prometeu em vídeo publicado em redes sociais nesta terça-feira restabelecer o Programa Emergencial de Retomada do Setor de Eventos (Perse) se vencer a eleição, afirmando que a medida valerá para as áreas de eventos, shows e turismo.
item.dc:creator: Bernardo Caram
item.content:encoded: O candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) prometeu em vídeo publicado em redes sociais nesta terça-feira restabelecer o Programa Emergencial de Retomada do Setor de Eventos (Perse) se vencer a eleição, afirmando que a medida valerá para as áreas de eventos, shows e turismo. O programa foi originalmente criado durante a pandemia de Covid-19 para socorrer o setor e teve elevado custo fiscal, com empresas de diferentes setores conseguindo acessar o benefício, que se prolongou bem além do período emergencial. A gestão do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conseguiu encerrar o programa após longa negociação com o Congresso Nacional sobre um plano de ajuste das contas públicas. De acordo com Flávio, o programa estimulará grandes e pequenos artistas e aquecerá a economia do país. “Onde tem eventos o comércio vende mais, o taxista e o uber faturam, os pequenos artistas prosperam e a economia gira”, disse na publicação. Em abril de 2024, o Congresso aprovou projeto do governo que estabeleceu o encerramento do programa de incentivo tributário para o setor de eventos quando atingisse um custo total de R$15 bilhões a partir daquele momento. A cifra foi alcançada em cerca de um ano e o Perse foi finalizado, com celebração de técnicos do governo. Após o anúncio de Flávio, duas fontes da equipe econômica do governo Lula disseram, sob condição de anonimato, que para além do custo elevado do Perse, o programa apresentava distorções e chegou a ser usado por empresas envolvidas em lavagem de dinheiro. "As operações Jogo de Sombras, Arena e Conto da Sorte apuraram uso de empresas de eventos para lavagem de dinheiro do jogo", disse uma delas em referência a operações policiais que miraram empresas de apostas online. Ainda em 2024, a Receita Federal também identificou mais de 2 mil empresas que usavam o incentivo fiscal sem que o Fisco tivesse registrado pedidos de habilitação para o benefício. Uma terceira fonte do governo destacou distorções no modelo do programa, que foi criado para socorrer empresas afetadas pelo fechamento de estabelecimentos comerciais durante a pandemia, mas teve como grande beneficiário o iFood, empresa que teve receitas fortemente multiplicadas durante a crise sanitária. Em 2025, a Reuters mostrou que o iFood pagou quase [USN:L1N3WC17R TEXT:"R$1 bilhão"] em tributos à Receita após o governo obter vitória na Justiça, que considerou indevido o uso dos benefícios do Perse. Na ocasião, a companhia argumentou que usufruiu do incentivo somente enquanto esteve vigente uma decisão judicial que a autorizava a fazê-lo.

item.title: S&P 500 y el Nasdaq caen ante nuevas dudas sobre la IA y el repunte del petróleo
item.description: Las dudas sobre la rentabilidad de la inteligencia artificial y el repunte del petróleo presionan a Wall Street. El desplome de Elice en Corea del Sur profundiza la cautela, mientras los bonos del Tes ...
item.dc:creator: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — Wall Street abre este martes con pérdidas, ante el renovado escepticismo sobre la rentabilidad de las inversiones en inteligencia artificial (IA) y el encarecimiento del petróleo por las tensiones con Irán. El sector tecnológico concentra las preocupaciones. Ver más: SpaceX presenta resultados ante Wall Street: qué esperar de su primer gran examen bursátil El deterioro del apetito por riesgo se extendió desde Asia, donde el Kospi surcoreano cayó 3,7%, hasta Europa, con un retroceso de 0,8% del Stoxx 600. El S&P 500 cae 0,15%, mientras el Nasdaq cede 0,46%. El Dow Jones Industrial sube 0,11%. En contraste, los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense recuperaron demanda como refugio. El Brent superó brevemente los US$111 por barril, mientras los inversionistas evalúan los riesgos para el suministro energético y las próximas decisiones de la Reserva Federal (Fed), en medio de persistentes presiones inflacionarias. La presión sobre las tecnológicas se intensificó tras el debut bursátil de Elice, empresa surcoreana de infraestructura de IA valorada en US$750 millones, cuyas acciones se desplomaron 32% en Seúl. El episodio profundizó las dudas sobre las denominadas neoclouds, compañías que financian centros de datos para ofrecer capacidad de procesamiento. Firmus canceló una salida a bolsa valorada en US$30.000 millones y CoreWeave ( CRWV ) acumula una caída superior a 60% desde su máximo. Las dificultades también alcanzan al crédito. Los bonos de CoreWeave llegaron a ofrecer rendimientos superiores a 15%, mientras el riesgo crediticio de SoftBank alcanzó su nivel más alto en casi cuatro años. Roger Lee, analista de Cavendish, señaló a Bloomberg que el mercado necesita pruebas de que las cuantiosas inversiones en infraestructura de IA generan retornos suficientes, algo que todavía resulta difícil de comprobar. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. La atención se traslada ahora a los resultados de SpaceX ( SPCX ) y Netflix ( NFLX ) este martes, seguidos por Tesla ( TSLA ) y Meta ( META ) el miércoles. Esta última será especialmente relevante para evaluar el ritmo de inversión de las grandes tecnológicas. Más allá de la tecnología, General Motors ( GM ) anunció una recompra de acciones por US$20.000 millones y ajustó su previsión anual de beneficio operativo a un rango de US$14.500 millones a US$15.500 millones. La automotriz obtuvo ganancias ajustadas de US$3,70 por acción, superiores a los US$3,56 esperados, aunque enfrenta menores volúmenes de ventas y presiones por las tasas de interés y los combustibles. Así se han comportado las acciones de General Motors. Símbolo: GM:UN. Clase de activo: equity. Por su parte, 3M ( MMM ) elevó su previsión anual de ganancias ajustadas a entre US$9,10 y US$9,15 por acción, tras superar las estimaciones trimestrales. La compañía también amplió su relación comercial con Amazon para suministrar productos destinados a centros de datos. GE Aerospace ( GE ) aumentó su proyección anual a entre US$8 y US$8,10 por acción, respaldada por la demanda de motores, repuestos y mantenimiento aeronáutico, pese al encarecimiento del combustible. El Brent alcanzó máximos de cinco meses ante la intensificación de los ataques iraníes contra buques en el estrecho de Ormuz. El crudo acumula un avance superior a 80% este año, mientras los precios del diésel europeo se han más que duplicado. Ver más: El principal riesgo para Wall Street podría no estar en las tasas altas, advierte Citi Aunque los flujos petroleros del Golfo recuperaron cerca de 80% de sus niveles anteriores a la guerra, las restricciones sobre combustibles refinados persisten. Francia consiguió compromisos adicionales de suministro de diésel de tres productores de Medio Oriente. El encarecimiento energético también afecta al oro, que retrocede 0,4%, hasta US$4.123,59 por onza. La posibilidad de una inflación más persistente limita las expectativas de flexibilización monetaria. Los rendimientos de los bonos estadounidenses a diez años descendieron cinco puntos básicos, hasta 5,09%, por la búsqueda de refugio. El mercado anticipa que la Fed mantendrá las tasas en su reunión del 28 de octubre, aunque contempla nuevas alzas antes de finalizar el año. En Europa, las protestas por el costo de vida y las preocupaciones fiscales elevaron a más de 150 puntos básicos el diferencial entre los bonos franceses y alemanes a diez años. La tensión también debilitó al euro. Felipe Barragán, estratega sénior de investigación de Pepperstone, advirtió que la recuperación de los bonos podría reflejar una respuesta defensiva más que una mejora estructural de las condiciones financieras. En América Latina, Brasil enfrenta la segunda vuelta presidencial del 25 de octubre, con mayor demanda de coberturas cambiarias y preocupaciones fiscales. En Chile, la producción de cobre podría alcanzar su menor nivel en 23 años. Ver más: Goldman Sachs advierte sobre riesgos en Wall Street y revela 23 acciones para protegerse Pese al deterioro bursátil, las acciones emergentes cotizan con un descuento récord de 53% frente a sus pares estadounidenses, según Bloomberg , mientras las expectativas de beneficios continúan al alza. La jornada estará marcada por los resultados empresariales y la evolución del petróleo. Para Barragán, el escenario favorece la selectividad, con especial atención a balances sólidos, generación de caja y menor dependencia del financiamiento externo. El dólar retrocede este martes frente a algunas de las principales divisas, en una jornada marcada por las dudas sobre la IA y las tensiones energéticas. Sin embargo, el movimiento no representa todavía un cambio de tendencia para la moneda estadounidense. Chris Turner, estratega de ING, considera que el billete verde debería mantener cierto respaldo, salvo que las acciones tecnológicas estadounidenses sufran una caída pronunciada. El analista identifica los riesgos financieros de los centros de datos y la incertidumbre energética como factores relevantes. Por su parte, los estrategas de BBVA describen el comportamiento del dólar como una fase de consolidación, más que una corrección sostenida. El banco prevé una leve debilidad a corto plazo, aunque considera que los elevados precios de la energía, la resiliencia económica estadounidense y las expectativas de nuevas alzas de tasas por parte de la Fed continúan como factores de apoyo. En medio de ese contexto, las monedas de América Latina tienen un desempeño mixto. El peso colombiano, el real brasileño y el peso chileno suben, mientras el peso mexicano y el argentino retroceden. - Una caída de Google Cloud en Londres interrumpió servicios bancarios de Revolut, Lloyds y otras entidades británicas. Revolut aseguró que los fondos y datos de sus clientes permanecen seguros. El incidente evidencia el riesgo operativo derivado de la concentración de infraestructura digital en pocos proveedores de nube como Google ( GOOGL ), Microsoft ( MSFT ) y Amazon ( AMZN ). - Codelco fijó una prima récord de US$350 por tonelada para suministrar cobre a clientes europeos en 2027, frente a US$325 este año. El aumento refleja la menor disponibilidad de metal en Europa tras el traslado de inventarios hacia EE.UU., aunque las dudas sobre posibles aranceles estadounidenses podrían liberar oferta y aliviar la presión sobre el mercado. - Halliburton ( HAL ) prevé varios años de mayor demanda de servicios petroleros por la reconstrucción de infraestructura energética en Medio Oriente. En el tercer trimestre, sus ingresos en Medio Oriente y Asia crecieron 8% a US$1.400 millones y el beneficio operativo ajustado alcanzó US$731 millones, superando expectativas. - El regulador británico propone obligar a Apple ( AAPL ) a abrir la tecnología de pagos sin contacto del iPhone a rivales y reducir las tarifas de acceso, lo que beneficiaría a firmas como Revolut, PayPal y Monzo. Las billeteras digitales ya son utilizadas por más de 60% de los adultos británicos, mientras Apple advierte posibles riesgos para la privacidad y seguridad.

item.title: 米一戸建て着工、9月4.6％減 許可件数は3年半ぶり低水準
item.description: [ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が２０日発表した９月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米一戸建て着工、9月4.6％減　許可件数は3年半ぶり低水準 10/20 22:42 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの住宅に掲げられた「売家」の看板。１月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が２０日発表した９月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の大部分を占める一戸建てが年率換算で前月比４．６％減の８５万９０００戸と、２０２５年９月以来、約１年ぶりの低水準となった。一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は４．０％減の８４万５０００戸と、２３年３月以来の低水準に落ち込んだ。住宅ローン金利の上昇が需要を抑制したことから着工・許可件数ともに大幅に減少し、住宅投資が第３・四半期に再び減少基調に戻ったことを示唆した。

一戸建て着工件数は前年同月比では２．６％増加した。地域別では、前月比で南部、中西部、西部で減少した一方、北東部では増加した。

一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は前年同月比で４．８％減少。地域別では、前月比で北東部、中西部、南部で減少し、西部は横ばいとなった。

変動の大きい５戸以上の集合住宅着工件数は７．２％減の３４万９０００戸。 前年同月比では２５．９％減少した。

全体の住宅着工件数は５．２％減の１２２万１０００戸。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１３０万５０００戸だった。前年同月比で７．４％減少した。

集合住宅の建設許可件数は５．９％増の５０万３０００戸。

全体の住宅建設許可件数は０．２％減の１４０万戸。エコノミスト予想は１３９万５０００戸だった。前年同月比では３．０％減少した。

住宅ローン金利はここ数週間で急上昇しており、米連邦住宅貸付抵当公社（フレディマック） のデータによると、先週の３０年固定住宅ローン金利平均は７．４０％と、ほぼ３年ぶりの高水準となった。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争がインフレをあおる中、借り入れコストの上昇は米国債利回りに連動している。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「住宅着工の低迷は驚くべきことではない。たとえ住宅建設業者が新築住宅を建てたとしても、誰にそれを買う余裕があるだろう」と指摘。「米政権が政策を１８０度転換し、新築住宅の価格をより手頃なものにしない限り、住宅市場は深刻な低迷期に入っていく」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/21(水) 0:03 ロイター

item.title: US stocks today: US stocks gain as healthcare stocks hit record high, oil prices fall
item.description: Wall Street's main indexes saw increases driven by a rally in healthcare stocks that reached record highs. Easing oil prices contributed to a recovery from the previous week's technology led selloff. Major companies like General Motors and Steel Dynamics reported disappointing earnings forecasts, while 3M and Equifax exceeded expectations. Investors are closely monitoring upcoming corporate earnings reports from several high-profile companies.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: Wall Street's main indexes climbed on Tuesday as healthcare stocks rallied to record highs and easing oil prices helped extend a recovery from last week's technology led selloff, according to Reuters.The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1.22%, while the S&P 500 gained 0.70% and the Nasdaq Composite added 0.59%. Healthcare and financial stocks led gains in the S&P 500, rising 1.8% and 1%, respectively, while energy stocks lagged.Brent crude fell 1.3% after briefly touching a near five month high, adding to the positive mood across broader markets, Reuters reported.Healthcare stocks lead reboundHealthcare stocks led the rebound, with S&P 500 Healthcare index rising 2.28% and hitting a record high. Eli Lilly rose 5.56% to $1,309 while United Health was up3.19% at $419.79.The gains came a day after the S&P 500 and Nasdaq extended their rebound as investors returned to technology stocks following last week's sharp selloff, which was partly driven by concerns over CoreWeave's debt load and the cost of financing the AI buildout, Reuters said.AI linked stocks were mixed on Tuesday. CoreWeave gained 1.6%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor index rose 0.4%. You're seeing some strength in some high value stocks and the Dow, and so that's helping to sort of lift the overall index, said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth, according to Reuters. Concerns about what's going on as far as semiconductors, that's still there and AI related names are down, but for the most part, the rest of the market is seeing a bit of a nice rebound. Earnings take centre stageInvestors were also looking to this week's corporate earnings for signs of whether companies can sustain growth amid mounting macroeconomic risks, Reuters reported.General Motors shares fell 5.3% after its full year earnings forecast came in below analysts' expectations. Steel Dynamics declined 1% after missing third quarter profit estimates.On the other hand, 3M jumped 5.3% after expanding its data centre partnership with Amazon and raising its full year profit forecast. Equifax gained 9.6% after reporting third quarter profit above analysts' estimates.The earnings calendar remained busy, with SpaceX and Netflix due to report after Tuesday's close, followed by Meta Platforms and Tesla on Wednesday.Meanwhile, South Korean AI infrastructure company Elice Group tumbled nearly 30% in its market debut, falling below its IPO price.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

item.title: Amazon to recruit over 300,000 workers for holiday season in first hiring jump in three years
item.description: Amazon said on Tuesday it plans to hire more than 300,000 workers for the US holiday season, marking the first increase in recruitment for the period in three years as the online retailer prepares for a surge in orders.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Amazon (AMZN.O) said on Tuesday it plans to hire more than 300,000 workers for the US holiday season, marking the first increase in recruitment for the period in three years as the online retailer prepares for a surge in orders. Here are more details: Amazon, which employed 250,000 workers during the season for the past three years, said it was hiring for seasonal, part-time and full-time roles across its US core operations for the period US holiday sales growth is expected to [USN:L6N461111 TEXT:"accelerate"] 4.2% from a year earlier to more than $1 trillion this year, the National Retail Federation forecast last week Starting next year, seasonal employees who work at least 30 hours per week will receive healthcare benefits offered to regular full-time employees, Amazon said Last week, retailer Walmart (WMT.O) [USN:L6N45Z0Z0 TEXT:"expanded"] healthcare benefits for its workforce, as surging healthcare expenses pressure Americans who are already facing rising costs of living Amazon, which [USN:L6N45T1CQ TEXT:"announced"] a small number of layoffs in its retail division earlier this month, said it would pay full-time employees a minimum of $20 per hour, with average pay reaching nearly $24, while average hourly wages for seasonal employees will be $20

item.title: El oro extiende su caída ante temores de inflación y dudas sobre las tasas de la Fed
item.description: El oro cotiza cerca de los US$4.120 por onza, presionado por el repunte del petróleo y los temores inflacionarios, mientras los operadores evalúan las perspectivas de tasas de interés de la Reserva Fe ...
item.dc:creator: Yihui Xie, Jack Ryan
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El oro cayó a medida que los elevados precios del petróleo avivaron las preocupaciones inflacionarias y ensombrecieron las perspectivas sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal. El oro cotizaba en torno a los US$4.120 la onza, tras una caída del 0,6% en la sesión anterior. El petróleo alcanzó su nivel más alto en cinco meses después de que Irán declarara que no le quedaba otra opción que imponer su control sobre el estrecho de Ormuz, mientras que los legisladores estadounidenses se oponían al acuerdo de exportación de diésel entre el presidente Donald Trump y Rusia. Ver más: El Brent alcanza máximo de cinco meses ante la amenaza de Irán sobre el estrecho de Ormuz El metal precioso se ha movido mayoritariamente en dirección opuesta al petróleo desde que estalló la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán a finales de febrero, ya que las interrupciones en los envíos de energía desde la región provocaron un aumento acelerado de la inflación y llevaron a los principales bancos centrales a endurecer la política monetaria. Unos costos de endeudamiento más elevados suelen ser un factor negativo para el oro, que no genera intereses. Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense se estabilizaron el martes, tras haber subido en la sesión anterior. El repunte de las acciones tecnológicas redujo la demanda de deuda pública estadounidense como activo refugio a principios de semana, lo que impulsó los rendimientos al alza y presionó al alza el precio del metal precioso. Los operadores intentan anticipar el próximo movimiento de la Reserva Federal en su lucha por controlar la inflación. El presidente Kevin Warsh, en un discurso pronunciado el viernes antes de un bloqueo de comunicaciones, no hizo nada por disipar las expectativas de que el banco central estadounidense mantendrá las tasas de interés estables en su reunión de la próxima semana. Ver más: Oro se desploma un 1,9% por temor a nuevas alzas de tasas de interés en EE.UU. tras dato de inflación Esto impulsó las apuestas a que la probabilidad de una subida de un cuarto de punto caiga por debajo del 20%, desde una probabilidad de dos entre tres a finales del mes pasado. El oro al contado cayó un 0,4% hasta los US$4.123,59 a las 12:32 en Londres. La plata se mantuvo estable en US$57,20, mientras que el platino cotizó en un rango estrecho y el paladio bajó. El índice Bloomberg Dollar Spot, que mide la fortaleza de la divisa estadounidense, descendió un 0,1% . En lo que va de octubre, el oro se ha mantenido generalmente por encima de los US$4.100, consolidándose tras una caída de más del 6% el mes anterior, a pesar de la fortaleza del dólar estadounidense y los altos rendimientos de los bonos. Aun así, ha caído cerca de una quinta parte desde que estalló el conflicto entre Estados Unidos e Irán a finales de febrero, y los operadores siguen viendo una probabilidad del 90% de que se produzca otra subida de tipos antes de que termine el año. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Polish power regulator wants wider EU battery rule exceptions to ease grid struggle
item.description: Companies running Poland's local power grids should be allowed to own batteries where they are needed to stabilise the network, the head of the country's energy regulator told Reuters, calling for wider exceptions to the European Union's energy storage rules.
item.dc:creator: Stefan Gardawski, Marta Maciag
item.content:encoded: Companies running Poland's local power grids should be allowed to own batteries where they are needed to stabilise the network, the head of the country's energy regulator told Reuters, calling for wider exceptions to the European Union's energy storage rules. Storage should not be opened up to grid operators everywhere, only where it is required, said Renata Mroczek, the president of the Energy Regulatory Office (URE), talking to Reuters on the sidelines of the European Forum for New Ideas conference in Sopot on Friday. EU rules generally bar grid operators, which are funded by fees on consumers’ bills, from owning batteries, so they cannot use that money to compete with private investors. Poland allows exceptions only for batteries URE deems integral to the grid. Historically coal-reliant Poland’s power system is struggling to keep up with more than 1.6 million small solar installations, think tank Forum Energii said, as grid-ordered cuts to renewable output more than doubled in 2025 to nearly 1.4 terawatt-hours. "Without more storage and its flexibility, it will be very difficult, if not impossible, to lower prices," Mroczek said. Contracts for power to be delivered throughout 2027 averaged 556 zlotys ($142) per megawatt-hour in September, up from 448 zlotys in June, data from Polish Power Exchange showed, above the average of 495 zlotys in this year’s regulated household tariffs. State Assets Minister Wojciech Balczun said in September that the government had not ruled out freezing household electricity prices again next year, Polish media reported. Mroczek said past price freezes had not fostered competition or encouraged households to look for better offers from suppliers. ($1 = 3.9021 zlotys)

item.title: Ibovespa orbita 208 mil pontos com aval de estrangeiros na reta final da eleição
item.description: O Ibovespa avançava nesta terça-feira, orbitando os 208 mil pontos, com investidores em clima de expectativas para o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, enquanto dados da B3 continuam mostrando fluxo de estrangeiros para as ações brasileiras.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa avançava nesta terça-feira, orbitando os 208 mil pontos, com investidores em clima de expectativas para o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, enquanto dados da B3 continuam mostrando fluxo de estrangeiros para as ações brasileiras. Por volta de 11h10, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) , referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, subia 1,49%, a 208.135,09 pontos. O volume financeiro somava R$9,2 bilhões. "O Ibovespa está em tendência de alta e mantém a resistência em 209.700 pontos – máxima histórica. Caso supere esse nível, abrirá novamente o caminho para mais valorizações, em busca dos 220.000 pontos no curto prazo e dos 245.000 pontos no médio prazo", afirmaram analistas do Itaú BBA no relatório Diário do Grafista. Do lado da baixa, acrescentaram, o índice encontra suporte em 203.000 pontos. Eles avaliam que a ausência de uma direção definida pode ser a tônica dos próximos dias, "com o mercado em compasso de espera antes de buscar uma direção mais clara". Pesquisas eleitorais seguem mostrando um cenário apertado da disputa presidencial, mas com o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ainda à frente numericamente do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) nas últimas pesquisas para o segundo turno da eleição, no próximo dia 25. Em paralelo, dados atualizados da B3 mostravam saldo de capital externo positivo de R$20,99 bilhões em outubro até o dia 16, de R$18,75 bilhões até a véspera. No exterior, a terça-feira era negativa nos mercados acionários norte-americanos, mas havia alívio nos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos, com o yield do Treasury de 10 anos marcando 5,1105%, de 5,136% na véspera. DESTAQUES BTG PACTUAL UNIT subia 4,09%, melhor desempenho entre os bancos do Ibovespa, que têm se mostrado sensíveis às expectativas eleitorais. BRADESCO PN , que reporta balanço no final da quinta-feira, avançava 2,59%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN valorizava-se 2,05%, BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) tinha elevação de 0,71% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT mostrava acréscimo de 0,54%. PETROBRAS PN avançava 1,14% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) subia 0,9%. O Brasil ultrapassou a Arábia Saudita como o segundo maior [USN:L6N4660QF TEXT:"fornecedor"] de petróleo bruto para a China nos primeiros nove meses de 2026, segundo dados alfandegários divulgados pelo país asiático nesta terça-feira. VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuava 0,92%, em linha com a fraqueza dos futuros do [USN:L6N4660RV TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China. MAGAZINE LUIZA ON (MGLU3.SA) disparava 6,76%, com o setor sensível a juros entre os destaques positivos em pregão com [USN:L1N4660J5 TEXT:"alívio"] na curva de juros brasileira. O amplo índice de consumo (.ICON) da B3 subia 2,79%. ÂNIMA EDUCAÇÃO ON (ANIM3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, perdia 6,54%, tendo como pano de fundo [USN:L1N465104 TEXT:"acordo"] da sua subsidiária de ensino de medicina Inspirali com o grupo de educação médica do Einstein para usar a marca do hospital em seus cursos a partir do próximo ano. O acordo de 20 anos envolve um pagamento fixo ao Einstein de R$150 milhões e pagamentos de 6% da receita líquida de novos alunos de medicina, entre outros detalhes. JSL ON (JSLG3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, avançava 7,64%, tendo no radar prévia de resultados mostrando [USN:S0N45000S TEXT:"receita bruta"] de R$3,09 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, alta de 5,9% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado. AMERICANAS ON (AMER3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, saltava 19,1%, após a Justiça do Rio de Janeiro decretar o [USN:L1N465112 TEXT:"encerramento"] do processo de recuperação judicial da companhia.

item.title: AstraZeneca-Amgen asthma drug hits 69% remission in esophageal disease trial
item.description: Amgen and AstraZeneca said on Tuesday their asthma drug helped reduce swallowing difficulties and achieved disease remission in 69% of patients with a type of chronic inflammatory disorder of the esophagus.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Amgen (AMGN.O) and AstraZeneca (AZN.L) said on Tuesday their asthma drug helped reduce swallowing difficulties and achieved disease remission in 69% of patients with a type of chronic inflammatory disorder of the esophagus. The result builds on August data, when AstraZeneca said the drug met the trial's main [USN:L6N44O0DF TEXT:"goals"] after 24 weeks of treatment by reducing esophageal inflammation and easing swallowing difficulties versus placebo. The drug Tezspire is being studied in patients with symptomatic and uncontrolled eosinophilic esophagitis, which causes swelling and irritation in the food pipe, making swallowing difficult and sometimes causing food to get stuck The monoclonal antibody blocks a protein called TSLP that drives the inflammatory pathway involved in both asthma and eosinophilic esophagitis About 65% on the 210 mg dose and 69% of patients on the 420 mg dose of the drug achieved remission of inflammation at 24 weeks, compared with 3.5% of patients on placebo The companies said the benefits were maintained through 52 weeks, with 67.8% of patients on the 210 mg dose and 63.3% on the 420 mg dose achieving disease remission, compared with 5.4% on placebo Tezspire reduced swallowing-difficulty scores by 18.8 points at the 210 mg dose and 22 points at the 420 mg dose after 24 weeks, compared with a 14.7-point reduction with placebo The most commonly reported side effects were upper respiratory infections, headache and diarrhea The drug is already approved in a number of countries as an add-on treatment for severe asthma and competes with Sanofi (SASY.PA) and Regeneron's (REGN.O) blockbuster drug Dupixent

item.title: Global warming is accelerating, leading climate scientist Rockström says
item.description: Global warming caused by fossil fuel emissions is accelerating, pushing many of the Earth's most important ecosystems close to their tipping points, said Johan Rockström, director of the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research.
item.dc:creator: Simon Jessop
item.content:encoded: Global warming caused by fossil fuel emissions is accelerating, pushing many of the Earth's most important ecosystems close to their tipping points, said Johan Rockström, director of the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research. Speaking at the Reuters Sustainability Europe conference on Tuesday, Rockström said damage to coral reefs and the Amazon rainforest was close to becoming irreversible. Parts of the Atlantic Ocean circulation system, including the current that moderates Western Europe's climate with warm water from the Caribbean, were close to collapse. The latest science confirms the world is on course to exceed a 1.5 degree Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) rise in average surface temperature in the next few years, increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events , he said, ahead of the United Nations' [USN:L1N45U06N TEXT:"COP31"] climate talks starting on November 9. Companies looking to prepare and build resilience into their operations should treat climate and nature as a single integrated agenda rather than separate issues, he said. While prioritising efforts to decarbonise, they should also invest in helping preserve nature, particularly projects related to maintaining or rebuilding biodiversity and reserves of fresh water. Rockström said it was "incredibly disturbing" to see lobbying for an easing of rules on phasing out internal combustion engine vehicles, pointing to subsidies for petrol and diesel that were undermining consumer demand for electric vehicles.

item.title: Así quedó distribuido el Presupuesto General de Colombia para 2027 por COP$634,9 billones
item.description: El último paso lo dio la plenaria de la Cámara de Representantes, que respaldó el proyecto de ley luego de que el Senado ya le hubiera dado luz verde. Las cuentas priorizan salud, pensiones y educació ...
item.dc:creator: María C. Suárez
item.content:encoded: Bogotá — El Congreso de la República aprobó el Presupuesto General de la Nación (PGN) para 2027 por COP$634,9 billones. El último paso lo dio la plenaria de la Cámara de Representantes, que respaldó el proyecto de ley luego de que el Senado ya le hubiera dado luz verde. Las cuentas priorizan salud, pensiones y educación, junto con subsidios de energía y gas, formación para el trabajo y seguridad. El ministro de Hacienda, Miguel Gómez Martínez , señaló que el ajuste más importante de la jornada fue la adición de COP$3 billones para el sector salud, que se suman a los COP$2 billones ya incluidos. Con ello, el sector contará con COP$5 billones para cubrir sus necesidades y hacer frente a la crisis que atraviesa, según el jefe de la cartera. Ver más: Banco central colombiano ya completa más de una cuarta parte de su meta de compra de dólares De acuerdo con Hacienda, la reformulación del PGN permitió reconocer necesidades de financiación que no estaban del todo contempladas en el proyecto que el Gobierno radicó inicialmente ante el Congreso. Además de salud, el presupuesto del sector Trabajo incorporó COP$6,5 billones adicionales para cumplir con las obligaciones pensionales. En educación superior pública se reconoció un faltante cercano a COP$700.000 millones para el funcionamiento de las universidades públicas. También quedó una partida específica de COP$9,6 billones para cubrir los compromisos del Fondo de Estabilización de Precios de los Combustibles (FEPC). Esos recursos no tenían una asignación explícita en la versión inicial del proyecto. El sector de Minas y Energía recibió COP$3 billones adicionales para subsidios de energía y gas. Incluyen apoyos al servicio de gas por red, al gas licuado de petróleo (GLP) y al transporte de combustibles líquidos en zonas de frontera. El sector Trabajo, en total, dispondrá de COP$66,9 billones. Además de las obligaciones pensionales, ese monto financia programas de protección social, formación para el empleo , productividad y emprendimiento , a través de entidades como el SENA. El PGN 2027 destina COP$82,8 billones a la seguridad del país, para sostener la operación de la Fuerza Pública y reforzar la investigación y la lucha contra el delito. De esa cifra, COP$74,9 billones van a Defensa y Policía, para el funcionamiento de las Fuerzas Militares y la Policía Nacional. La Fiscalía General de la Nación tendrá COP$7,8 billones, con COP$100.000 millones adicionales para fortalecer su capacidad organizacional y operativa. Ver más: ¿Cómo planear las inversiones en la BVC para 2027? Estas son las tres acciones que recomiendan comprar En contraste, la Jurisdicción Especial para la Paz (JEP) verá reducido su presupuesto en COP$181.400 millones: un ajuste inicial de COP$170.000 millones y un recorte adicional de COP$11.400 millones. Esos recursos se trasladaron al Ministerio de Defensa. Según Hacienda, la reducción no afectará el funcionamiento de la JEP ni el cumplimiento de sus funciones misionales. La inversión pública sumará COP$94,8 billones, COP$7,9 billones más que lo aprobado en primer debate. El aumento salió de una redistribución interna, sin modificar el monto total del PGN. El texto aprobado incluye además medidas de austeridad, como la reducción de gastos no esenciales y mecanismos para hacer seguimiento al uso de los recursos. Con la aprobación, el Gobierno busca reconocer sus obligaciones fiscales y atender las necesidades de financiación del Estado.

item.title: US health agency confirms third measles-related death this year
item.description: A third person died due to measles in the United States, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed on its website on Tuesday, as the country battles the largest measles outbreak in decades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A third person died due to measles in the United States, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed on its website on Tuesday, as the country battles the largest measles outbreak in decades. There were 4,410 confirmed cases of measles across the country as of October 15, according to the agency. It had reported [USN:L4N45L13A TEXT:"two deaths"] related to the once-eliminated disease in September. The agency has not disclosed the states in which the three deaths occurred. The US Department of Health and Human Services, which oversees the CDC, told Reuters that the National Center for Health Statistics received another report of a measles-related death and verified that the disease was the underlying cause. Under US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the CDC has drawn scrutiny for switching to NCHS mortality data to track measles deaths, replacing its earlier reliance on state health departments' figures. The CDC has said its death count could change as reviews are completed. The federal death toll remains lower than numbers reported by state officials. In Pennsylvania, the state hardest hit by the resurgence, local health authorities have reported at [USN:L4N45M1NB TEXT:"least five deaths"] linked to the disease this year. State officials are also reviewing an [USN:L4N45Y148 TEXT:"additional death"] reported by the Franklin County coroner. Pennsylvania has reported 1,286 cases as of October 19. Last week, the CDC said it would deploy [USN:L4N45Z1Q3 TEXT:"additional support to Pennsylvania"] to help investigate the ongoing measles outbreak after the state formally asked for federal aid through the agency's Epi-Aid emergency response program. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease but can be prevented through the measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine, which is about 97% effective after two doses.

item.title: Can Strait of Hormuz become ‘redundant’ in 5 years as Iran war drags on? Here are the alternate routes for Gulf states
item.description: The US-Iran war has exposed the Strait of Hormuz’s vulnerability, prompting Gulf nations to explore alternative oil routes. HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery says it could become “redundant” in five years. But can pipelines, ports and IMEC reduce dependence on the critical chokepoint?
item.dc:creator: Bhanu Pratap
item.content:encoded: The Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most critical energy chokepoints, could become “redundant” within five years as Gulf nations invest in alternative pipelines, ports and logistics networks, HSBC Group CEO Georges Elhedery said on Tuesday, according to Reuters. The Iran war has exposed the risks of relying on the narrow waterway for energy exports, prompting regional governments to explore routes that can transport crude oil to international markets without passing through the strait. “We do see this region being able to recover and then continue growing. It will mean a lot of investment,” Elhedery said at the HSBC Future Forum in Dubai. “Of course, we do wish and hope to see a resolution to the conflict ... But Hormuz, probably in five years' time, may become redundant,” he added, according to Reuters. Alternatives to Hormuz are not entirely new. Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) already operate crude oil pipelines that bypass the strait. The bigger question is whether expanding these routes and building new infrastructure can significantly reduce the Gulf's dependence on the waterway. Diversifying supply routes could help reduce some of these risks. 1. Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline: From the Gulf to the Red Sea Route: Abqaiq in eastern Saudi Arabia to Yanbu on the Red Sea coast. Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, also known as Petroline, is one of the most significant existing alternatives to the Strait of Hormuz. The pipeline transports crude oil from processing facilities in eastern Saudi Arabia across the Arabian Peninsula to Yanbu. From there, oil can be loaded onto tankers and shipped to international markets without passing through Hormuz. The pipeline gives Saudi Arabia the option of redirecting substantial volumes of crude towards the Red Sea, reducing its reliance on shipping lanes inside the Persian Gulf. Red Sea shipping also faces security risks due to the Iran-aligned Houthis. 2. UAE's Habshan-Fujairah pipeline: Bypassing the strait Route: Habshan in Abu Dhabi to Fujairah on the Gulf of Oman. The UAE has another major alternative in the Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline, also known as ADCOP. The approximately 400-km pipeline connects onshore oil facilities at Habshan with Fujairah, which lies outside the Strait of Hormuz. The pipeline has a reported capacity of around 1.8 million barrels per day, as per reports. The UAE already uses this route to export crude. Fujairah allows the UAE to load crude onto tankers without sending them through Hormuz. Expanding pipeline capacity, storage facilities and port infrastructure could help the country maintain exports during future disruptions. 3. More pipelines, ports and logistics infrastructure Beyond existing pipelines, Gulf countries could invest in additional pipeline capacity, export terminals, storage facilities and transport links connecting oil-producing regions with ports outside the strait. The objective would be to build greater redundancy into regional energy supply chains. New routes would also need to be commercially viable and capable of handling large volumes reliably. 4. Can IMEC offer an alternative to Hormuz? The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), announced at the G20 Summit in New Delhi in September 2023, is another connectivity initiative attracting attention amid instability in the Middle East. The proposed corridor aims to connect India with the Gulf and Europe through an integrated network of shipping routes, ports, railways and other infrastructure. Its broader objective is to improve trade and logistics connectivity between the three regions. The ongoing crises in the Middle East, including the Gaza war, tensions involving Iran and the risk of disruption around the Strait of Hormuz, have strengthened the case for more resilient trade routes, according to Gérard Mestrallet, special envoy of the French president for IMEC. “The difficulties — October 7, Gaza, Iran, Hormuz — have even increased the necessity to have a resilient corridor, offering several possibilities to the market,” Mestrallet said. For India, IMEC's potential lies in strengthening connectivity with Gulf markets and Europe. However, it is a proposed multimodal trade corridor, not an operational crude oil pipeline designed to carry the volumes currently shipped through the strait. Can these alternatives really make Hormuz redundant? Existing pipeline alternatives offer a way to redirect some crude oil exports, but they cannot yet replicate the scale of flows through the Strait of Hormuz. The IEA estimates that Saudi Arabia and the UAE have a combined 3.5 million to 5.5 million barrels per day of potential capacity on alternative routes that could bypass the strait. This compares with approximately 20 million barrels per day of oil shipments that passed through Hormuz in 2025. The agency has also cautioned that the logistics required to reroute and export large volumes have not been robustly tested. There is another important limitation: bypass pipelines primarily address crude oil exports. They do not automatically provide an alternative for all LNG shipments passing through Hormuz, including supplies from Qatar. Gas exports require specialised infrastructure. Additional pipelines and export terminals could provide valuable flexibility during a crisis, but the scale of investment required to replicate its role remains substantial, making it unlikely that the Strait of Hormuz can be rendered entirely redundant in the near future. With inputs from Reuters.

item.title: US single-family housing starts plunge; building permits hit 3-1/2-year low
item.description: US single-family homebuilding fell sharply in September and permits for future construction tumbled to a 3-1/2-year low as higher mortgage rates suppressed demand, suggesting residential investment resumed its declining trend in the third quarter.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: US single-family homebuilding fell sharply in September and permits for future construction tumbled to a 3-1/2-year low as higher mortgage rates suppressed demand, suggesting residential investment resumed its declining trend in the third quarter. The report from the Commerce Department on Tuesday followed on the heels of a National Association of Home Builders survey on Monday showing sentiment among [USN:S0N44H00H TEXT:"single-family homebuilders"] plunged in October to the lowest level since June 2012. The deterioration in sentiment was blamed on rising material costs and mortgage rates as well as more expensive diesel and "worsening" labor conditions amid an immigration crackdown. Expensive mortgages have combined with still-elevated home prices to create what economists have called an affordability crisis, which is dominating campaign messaging ahead of the crucial November 3 [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. President Donald Trump earlier this year refused to sign a bipartisan housing affordability bill, calling it "a big yawn" as he pressed Congress, including fellow Republicans resisting his demands, to first pass separate and contentious voting requirements legislation. The housing bill became law without Trump's signature. "The weakness in housing starts is not surprising. Even if homebuilders were putting up new houses, who could afford to buy them?" said Christopher Rupkey, chief economist at FWDBONDS. "The housing market is about to go into a deep sleep unless Washington can do a 180 on its policies and make the cost of a new home more affordable." Single-family housing starts, which account for the bulk of homebuilding, dropped 4.6% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 859,000 units last month, the lowest level since September 2025, the Commerce Department's Census Bureau said. Homebuilding fell over the month in the South, Midwest and West regions, but increased in the Northeast. Single-family starts rose 2.6% on a year-on-year basis in September. Mortgage rates have surged in recent weeks, with the 30-year fixed rate averaging 7.40% last week, the highest level in nearly three years, data from mortgage finance firm Freddie Mac showed. The higher borrowing costs are tracking Treasury yields as the US-Israeli war with Iran [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"fans inflation"]. Slumping sales have led to a glut of unsold houses on the market, further reducing the incentive for developers to break ground on new single-family housing projects. Despite the overhang of new single-family homes, there is a national housing shortage, which is keeping home prices elevated. OIL PRICE SHOCK Single-family building permits decreased 4.0% to a rate of 845,000 units, the lowest level since March 2023. Permits fell in the Northeast, Midwest and South regions, but were unchanged in the West. They dropped 4.8% year-on-year in September. Residential investment rebounded in the second quarter, also reflecting renovations, making a small contribution to gross domestic product. The rise followed five straight quarterly declines. Some economists said construction workers were being pulled away from homebuilding to work on data centers. "Add to that uncertainty among both builders and buyers about inflation, and our best assessment is that starts will falter in the months ahead until the energy shock is better understood," said Carl Weinberg, chief economist at High Frequency Economics. "So don’t bet on residential construction to recover anytime soon." But some economists viewed the slump in single-family homebuilding as necessary given the inventory bloat, with the NAHB survey also showing buyer traffic slumping in October to the lowest level since April 2012. "So, if builders just proceeded without making an adjustment, inventories would quickly back up," said Stephen Stanley, chief US economist at Santander US Capital Markets. "Hopefully, the slower pace of starts will prevent the market from getting too far out of balance." Starts for housing projects with five units or more, a very volatile segment, plummeted 7.2% to a rate of 349,000 units in September. Multifamily housing starts plunged 25.9% on a year-over-year basis. Overall housing starts decreased 5.2% to a pace of 1.221 million units. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast starts dropping to a rate of 1.305 million units. They declined 7.4% on a year-over-year basis in September. Building permits for multifamily housing projects increased 5.9% to a rate of 503,000 units last month. Overall building permits fell 0.2% to a rate of 1.400 million units. Economists had forecast permits falling to a rate of 1.395 million units. Permits dropped 3.0% on a year-over-year basis in September.

item.title: ドイツ、防衛・半導体・ＡＩに重点投資へ 首相が投資家に表明
item.description: [ベルリン ２０日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２０日、投資家に向けて演説し、長期的な生産性と経済的な自立性を...

item.content:encoded:
ドイツ、防衛・半導体・ＡＩに重点投資へ　首相が投資家に表明 10/20 21:37 配信

ベルリンで開催された「Invest in Germanyサミット」で演説するメルツ首相、20日撮影 REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

[ベルリン ２０日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２０日、投資家に向けて演説し、長期的な生産性と経済的な自立性を高めるため、防衛や半導体、人工知能（ＡＩ）などの分野に重点的に投資していると述べた。

ベルリンでのイベントで「皆さんにとって最善の事業環境を整えることが目標だ」と語り、欧州最大の経済国であるドイツへの投資を呼びかけた。イベントにはエネルギー企業バルカン・エナジーや防衛企業ヘルシングなどの代表者が出席した。

メルツ氏は、成長の加速や海外からの直接投資の増加、スタートアップ設立の増加を挙げ、政策の効果が既に経済に表れていると述べた。

またドイツ企業が２０２８年までに８０００億ユーロ（８９８４億ドル）超を投資すると約束した「メード・フォー・ジャーマニー」構想を紹介した。

欧州の経済統合が進めば企業が欧州連合（ＥＵ）の単一市場を活用しやすくなると指摘。欧州共通の企業制度「ＥＵ Ｉｎｃ．」をできるだけ早く導入すると約束した。

技術競争力を強化する幅広い取り組みの一環として、ドイツは３０年までにＡＩの計算能力を４倍に引き上げることを目指していると述べた。

この目標を後押しするため、ＡＩ規制が「実現する前に道を閉ざすのではなく、道を開くもの」となるよう、自ら「欧州レベルで関与している」と語った。

item.description: Oct 20 : Former Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag has blamed Cristiano Ronaldo's lack of fitness and preparation for the forward's struggles during his second stint at the club, saying the Portugal international "let the team down."Ronaldo won three Premier League titles under Alex Ferguson before leavin

Ronaldo let Man United down, says club's former boss Ten Hag

FILE PHOTO: Soccer Football - Premier League - Aston Villa v Manchester United - Villa Park, Birmingham, Britain - November 6, 2022 Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag talks to Cristiano Ronaldo before the start of the second half REUTERS/Carl Recine/ File Photo

FAST

Oct 20 : Former Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag has blamed Cristiano Ronaldo's lack of fitness and preparation for the forward's struggles during his second stint at the club, saying the Portugal international "let the team down." Ronaldo won three Premier League titles under Alex Ferguson before leaving United for Real Madrid in 2009, and returned to Old Trafford in 2021. But under Dutchman Ten Hag, Ronaldo struggled in the 2022-23 season, scoring once in 10 league appearances before leaving the club in November 2022. "He let the team down, and he let me down, because we planned with him," Ten Hag told The Athletic in an interview published on Tuesday.

Reuters has contacted Ronaldo's representatives for comment. Ten Hag, who guided United to a third-place league finish in 2022-23, said he had confronted Ronaldo about the player's performance. "Many times I say, 'Ronnie, everyone wants to work for you to bring you in the right position, but if you can't bring yourself in the box, you can't score.' He was not capable to do this," said Ten Hag, who was sacked by United in 2024. "It's the wrong idea to put this to me that I expected him to do the pressing, that he's exhausted. But he couldn't. He ran neither in possession nor out of possession. The reason was because he didn't prepare himself." Ronaldo joined Saudi club Al-Nassr in December 2022 and scored 14 league goals in 16 appearances before the end of the season. "Obviously, he's one of the best in football history. I respected him a lot. But at that time, as a manager, I had to make a rational decision and keep the players I admire in," said Ten Hag. Ronaldo, Portugal's all-time leading scorer with 146 goals, was handed a 30-day ban by the country's football federation on Monday after he left the national team camp following a rift with coach Jorge Jesus. The 41-year-old forward is expected to play for Al-Nassr in a Saudi Pro League game later on Tuesday. He is 19 goals short of scoring 1,000 in his career.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Seher Dareen
[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２０日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＩＥＡ、石油備蓄の追加放出にいつでも対応可能＝事務局長 10/20 21:35 配信

国際エネルギー機関のロゴ、パリで2023年撮影 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier/File Photo

Seher Dareen

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２０日、加盟国の緊急石油備蓄を追加放出する必要が生じた場合、ＩＥＡはいつでも対応できると述べた。

ＩＥＡは先週、３月に表明された過去最大規模の緊急石油備蓄放出のうち、未放出分の供給を前倒しすることを決めた。この一環として２０００万バレルを超える軽油をできるだけ早く放出し、供給を増やして価格高騰を抑える。

ビロル氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズがロンドンで主催した会議で、追加放出の可能性を問われ、「必要になり、加盟国が実行に移す時だと判断すれば、ＩＥＡとしていつでも対応できる」と述べた。

「軽油をできるだけ早く供給できるよう取り組んでいる」と語ったが、２０００万バレルの放出の具体的な時期は示さなかった。「放出量と時期は各国の判断や冬場の市場情勢次第だ」とした。

ＩＥＡは先進国による緊急石油備蓄の放出を調整している。３月には価格高騰を受け、加盟国が原油と石油製品の計４億バレル超の放出を表明していた。ビロル氏によると、加盟国はこれまでに４億バレルの８０％を放出した。

item.title: Kremlin says work is ongoing to ease humanitarian situation in Russian-controlled town of Oleshky
item.description: The Kremlin said on Tuesday that work was under way to ease the humanitarian situation in the Russian-controlled town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine, where residents have reported a worsening food crisis.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Kremlin said on Tuesday that work was under way to ease the humanitarian situation in the Russian-controlled town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine, where residents have reported a [USN:L8N45K1N1 TEXT:"worsening food crisis"]. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters that President Vladimir Putin had discussed the situation in Oleshky with US President Donald Trump and told him that Russia's human rights commissioner was engaged on the issue. Putin told Pope Leo in a phone call on Friday that he [USN:S8N44A06B TEXT:"supported a Vatican initiative"] to help deliver supplies to civilians in Oleshky and was ready to cooperate on the matter. Russia and Ukraine both accuse each other of blocking supplies to the population of the town which Ukrainian forces want to retake.

item.title: El dólar cae por preocupaciones sobre la IA, el euro sube a pesar de disturbios en Francia
item.description: El dólar caía el martes al resurgir las dudas sobre el comercio relacionado con la inteligencia artificial, mientras que el euro subía levemente a pesar de las persistentes preocupaciones de los operadores por los disturbios en Francia.
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell
item.content:encoded: El dólar caía el martes al resurgir las dudas sobre el comercio relacionado con la inteligencia artificial, mientras que el euro subía levemente a pesar de las persistentes preocupaciones de los operadores por los disturbios en Francia. * Las acciones de la empresa surcoreana de servicios de IA Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) se desplomaron un 32% en su debut en la bolsa de Seúl, una señal de que el sentimiento negativo hacia el sector de la IA en los mercados mundiales no está remitiendo. * Las fuertes entradas de capital en la bolsa estadounidense han respaldado al dólar. El aumento de las tasas de interés, impulsado en parte por las expectativas de crecimiento e inflación vinculadas al sector, también ha contribuido a ello. * El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye al yen y al euro, caía un 0,27% a 101,69, mientras que el euro subía un 0,2% a 1,1232 dólares. * Los operadores se mantenían cautelosos con respecto al euro a pesar de las modestas subidas del martes, ya que Francia se enfrenta a protestas generalizadas y a un panorama fiscal cada vez más sombrío. * El Gobierno dijo que los toques de queda nocturnos en las zonas afectadas por la violencia de las principales ciudades francesas habían supuesto un respiro frente a los peores disturbios que ha vivido el país en años. Se prevén más protestas para el fin de semana. * La libra esterlina se apreciaba un 0,66%, a 1,339 dólares, después de que los datos del mercado laboral mostraron un mercado laboral resistente, la última serie de datos del Reino Unido que sorprendió al alza. * Según datos de LSEG, los mercados están descontando casi por completo una subida de tasas de 25 puntos básicos por parte del Banco de Inglaterra en su próxima reunión, el 5 de noviembre. * El yen subía después de que una subasta de bonos del Estado japonés (JGB) a largo plazo registró una demanda récord. La moneda japonesa ganaba un 0,29% frente al dólar, a 158,04 unidades por dólar.

item.title: GM shares sink as full-year profit forecast misses Wall Street estimates
item.description: General Motors’ third-quarter core profit rose sharply on the back of strong pickup truck sales, but its shares fell on Tuesday after the automaker’s earnings-per-share forecast for the full year fell ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: General Motors’ third-quarter core profit rose sharply on the back of strong pickup truck sales, but its shares fell on Tuesday after the automaker’s earnings-per-share forecast for the full year fell short of analyst expectations. The company said quarterly earnings before interest and tax, not including one-time items (adjusted EBIT), rose 22 per cent from a year earlier, to US per cent4.1 billion. That amounted to per cent3.70 per share, topping analyst expectations of per cent3.63, according to LSEG data. GM said it expected to end 2026 with adjusted EBIT in the range of per cent14.5 billion to per cent15.5 billion, narrowed from previous guidance of per cent14 billion to per cent16 billion. It tightened its annual adjusted earnings-per-share forecast to between per cent12.75 and per cent13.75, the midpoint of which is below analysts’ estimates of per cent13.41, according to data compiled by LSEG. GM shares fell about four per cent in premarket trading. Confidence in ‘27 GM said it remained confident despite inflationary pressures from higher logistics and energy costs, tariffs and other expenses. Commodity inflation, including higher expenses for logistics and computer chips, would total about per cent2 billion this year, the high end of its previous forecast, it said. Its board approved a multi-year, per cent20 billion stock buyback program. GM has bought back about per cent29.5 billion of its own shares since 2023, driving down its overall share count to help its per-share profit results. In the third quarter, it sold a higher mix of large pickup trucks and fewer electric vehicles, which helped the bottom line. The company has been pulling back on sales of EVs, which historically have lost money, following the Trump administration’s withdrawal of support for them. Revenue totaled per cent50 billion, up 2.9 per cent from a year earlier. In North America, the profit margin improved to 8.7 per cent, from 6.2 per cent a year earlier, despite a slight decline in quarterly sales. GM said “the path forward is more challenging,” but reiterated that it expects next year’s results to be better, assuming continued strong consumer demand and a moderating of cost pressures on commodities and logistics. (Reporting by Kalea Hall; Editing by Mike Colias, Kirsten Donovan and Joe Bavier)

item.title: Salesforce deepens AI bets with $5.66 billion Braze deal
item.description: Salesforce said on Tuesday it would acquire Braze in a deal valued at about $5.66 billion, eyeing the New York-based company's AI-driven personalization tools to strengthen its business software offerings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Salesforce (CRM.N) said on Tuesday it would acquire Braze (BRZE.O) in a deal valued at about $5.66 billion, eyeing the New York-based company's AI-driven personalization tools to strengthen its business software offerings. The deal is the latest bet by Salesforce to accelerate its AI transition as investors worry that the rapid adoption of the technology could erode demand for traditional software. Braze Class A shareholders will receive $47.50 in cash per share held, representing a premium of about 58.1% to the stock's last close. Shares of Braze jumped more than 50% in early trading while Salesforce's stock dipped. Braze's AI tools help marketers optimize content, offers, channels and timing, and let brands send personalized messages to customers and respond to their behavior in real time. The company serves about 2,770 customers including Canva, Dairy Queen, Equinox, Instacart, Urban Outfitters and Venmo. The transaction is expected to close in Salesforce's fiscal year 2028, subject to required approvals. The company does not expect the deal to change its fiscal 2027 forecast. Salesforce has been doubling down on its AI offering and signed a $3.6 billion deal for [USN:L6N42N0XU TEXT:"AI agent platform Fin"] earlier this year and an $8 billion deal for [USN:L3N3RZ0OR TEXT:"Informatica"] last year. Salesforce would pay a $300 million termination fee, while Braze would pay $191.4 million if it abandons the deal. J.P. Morgan Securities is the exclusive financial adviser to Salesforce, while Qatalyst Partners is advising Braze.

Oct 20 : Apple said on Tuesday it has committed to purchasing up to $100 million of titanium over three years from a Pennsylvania-based company as part of the iPhone maker's push to expand manufacturing in the United States. The purchase agreement with Perryman Company, part of Apple's American Manufacturing Program, covers titanium for various products, including its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. Here are more details: • Perryman will melt, forge and roll titanium with at least 80 per cent recycled content at its site in Houston, Pennsylvania
